steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); })()

steps.name: place-grid
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = [ ['wall-shelf',{}], ['wall-shelf',{style:'ledge'}], ['wall-shelf',{style:'corner'}], ['wall-shelf',{style:'twotier'}], ['wall-shelf',{style:'floating'}], ['side-table',{}], ['side-table',{set:'nest2'}], ['side-table',{set:'nest3'}], ['side-table',{shape:'square'}], ['side-table',{shape:'drum'}], ['bar-table',{}], ['bar-table',{shape:'round'}], ['bar-table',{tableHeight:0.92}], ['bar-stool',{}], ['bar-stool',{style:'backed'}], ['bar-stool',{style:'pedestal'}], ['bar-stool',{style:'step'}], ['bar-stool',{style:'kitchen'}], ['office-chair',{}], ['office-chair',{style:'executive'}], ['office-chair',{style:'mesh'}], ['office-chair',{style:'gaming'}], ['armchair',{}], ['armchair',{style:'wingback'}], ['armchair',{style:'tub'}], ['armchair',{style:'swivel'}] ]; const cols = 7; const dx = 1.5, dz = 1.8, x0 = 1.0, z0 = -7.5; const pos = {}; const list = items.map(([defId, props], i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols); const x = x0 + c * dx, z = z0 + r * dz; const key = defId + ':' + JSON.stringify(props); pos[key] = [x, z]; return { id: 'audit-' + i, defId, position: [x, z], rotation: 0, props }; }); window.__auditPos = pos; s.setItems(list); return list.length; })()

steps.name: frame-bartable
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['bar-table:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.6, p[1]], radius: 1.1 }); })()

steps.name: frame-barstool-row
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['bar-stool:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0] + 1.6, 0.4, p[1]], radius: 2.4 }); })()
